errors.text_span: Според легендата, най-долното синьо ниво отговаря за „Акции (без АДСИЦ)“, зеленото – за „Облигации“, червено – за „Акции на АДСИЦ“
errors.evidence: The description lists the stacked layers in the wrong order. It states the order is blue, then green, then red, but the actual stacking order in the chart is blue at the bottom, then dark red, then green.

The description incorrectly states that the height of each layer represents the 'relative contribution' (относителния внос). The height of each layer represents its absolute value in 'Млн. лв.', not a relative percentage of the total.

errors.text_span: а някои от тях са визуално подчертани чрез различни цветове и слоеве, които са описани в легендата.
errors.evidence: This phrase is confusing and redundant. It implies that only 'some' of the bars are highlighted with colors, when in fact all bars are constructed this way as part of the stacked bar chart's design. The phrasing is awkward and does not add meaningful information.
